shortDescription: Manages virtual gateway on Check Point Gateway over Web Services API

options.name: id
options.description: Virtual gateway ID. This parameter is used to change an existing virtual gateway or create a new one if it does not exist.

options.name: interfaces
options.description: Configure interfaces for the virtual gateway. Collection of interfaces to be set, identified by the name. Replaces existing interfaces.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the virtual gateway. This parameter is used to change an existing virtual gateway by name.

options.name: one_time_password
options.description: One-time password of the virtual gateway. This parameter is used to set the one-time password for an existing virtual gateway by name or ID.

options.name: state
options.description: Ansible state which can be C(present) or C(absent).

options.name: virtual_switches
options.description: Connect virtual gateway identified by name or ID to pre-existing virtual switches identified by their IDs. Collection of virtual switches to be set, identified by their IDs. Replaces existing interfaces.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for task or return immediately.
